title: Your Best Seller Might Earn the Least Per Plate

scenes.say: Your best seller might be the dish that earns you the least on every plate.

props.headline: Your best seller might earn the *least* per plate

scenes.say: Say your smash burger sells for sixteen dollars. The beef, bun, cheese, fries and sauce cost six dollars twenty, so you keep nine dollars eighty a plate.
Now the quiet one. A fourteen dollar mushroom pasta costs three dollars ten to make, so it keeps ten dollars ninety. Cheaper for the guest, and better for you.
That's one dollar ten more on every plate. Nudge just twenty burger orders a week towards the pasta, and that's eleven hundred and forty-four dollars more a year.
So: cost every dish, not just your top five. Put the quiet earners where eyes land on the menu. And try your best seller one dollar higher.
